title: Refactor Code for Better Readability
description: Refactor the following working but messy code to make it more readable, maintainable, and follow Python best practices.
context: The code below works correctly but is hard to read and maintain. It needs refactoring to improve code quality while maintaining the same functionality.
requirements: Improve variable names to be more descriptive
Break down the large function into smaller, focused functions
Add docstrings and comments where appropriate
Maintain the exact same functionality and test results
success_criteria: All original test cases still pass
Code is more readable and well-organized
hints: Use descriptive variable names like 'numbers' instead of 'l'
Consider using built-in functions like min(), max(), sum()
Add a docstring explaining what the function does
Consider creating separate functions for different calculations
